g.text: TrendDetective (main @ a6e430f) — Data contracts between the work areas
geometry: Polygon (CCW ring) or Point, [lng, lat] WGS84
geojson: {type, id?, data: FeatureCollection, outline?, fillOpacity?}
topics.<name>.station: {id, name, latitude, longitude, elevation, distance_km} | null
topics.<name>.error: str (only if the topic failed)
map_layers[0] "user-request-results": one feature per topic, colour = slope sign
time: 1-D numbers (e.g. days since start), unique
values: 1-D finite numbers, same length, n ≥ 3
